name: Object Oriented Programming
topics: OOP Concepts and C++ Basics
Explain five characteristics of OOP; are encapsulation and data abstraction the same?
Explain derived and user-defined data types, type casting (implicit and explicit), references vs pointers, and dynamic memory allocation.
Output Prediction in C++
Find the output of the given program using the comma operator / pointer increment.
Find the output of the given constructor–destructor program and explain the execution order.
Functions: Inline, Default Arguments, Call by Reference
Write a program using an inline function to find the minimum of two numbers; how does it differ from default arguments?
Square an integer using call by pointer and call by reference.
Classes, Static Members and Friend Functions
Write an EMPLOYEE class with a static counter; explain two uses of static.
Use a friend function to swap private data of two classes / compare areas of Rectangle and Triangle; how does a friend differ from a member function?
Constructors and Copy Constructors
Why is a copy constructor used? Demonstrate with a program.
Differentiate default and parameterised constructors.
Operator and Function Overloading
Overload the unary ++ operator for the given Time class using member and friend functions.
Calculate the area of a rectangle or circle using function overloading; explain compile-time polymorphism.
Inheritance, Virtual Functions and Abstract Classes
Show the order of constructor calls in multiple inheritance; demonstrate a virtual base class and the protected specifier.
Create the abstract UniversityEmployee class with a pure virtual salary() and derived teaching/non-teaching classes; design the student–test–sports–result hierarchy.
File Handling in C++
Count the characters, words and lines in a text file.
Write student records to Pass.txt or Fail.txt based on marks; explain random file access.
Exception Handling and Namespaces
Explain exception handling with a diagram and show multiple catch blocks for one try.
Throw a divide-by-zero exception; explain the scope resolution operator and using in namespaces.
Java: Features, Packages, Interfaces, Inheritance, Threads
Explain why Java is secure and portable and the JVM; differentiate abstract classes and interfaces.
Explain packages, multithreading and multilevel inheritance using super with programs.
